frontmatter.value: Epic-scale planning agent that fully scopes an epic before any execution. It decomposes the objective into child features, computes the dependency graph and wave layering, assesses per-feature complexity, drives per-feature preparation (promotion, research, spec/user-story, atomic plan, preflight clearance) through parallel preparation-mode Agent(orchestrator) delegations, commits all planning outputs to the epic integration branch, and emits the epic-orchestrator kickoff prompt artifact. Performs no atomic execution. Must not be invoked from an orchestrator agent (enforced by enforce-epic-invocation-origin.ps1).

- policy-compliance-order
  - epic-plan
  - epic-orchestrate
  - feature-promotion-lifecycle
  - atomic-plan-contract
  - evidence-and-timestamp-conventions

keys.value: "Root-invoked epic planning coordinator that decomposes an epic, prepares every child through preflight, commits the planning state, and stops before execution."
